revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Buying Popcorn
revealWordProblem.text:
You go to the movie theater with your family, and your family likes to buy popcorn to snack on during the movie. The theater sells three different-sized boxes of popcorn. Small: width 4 in., $4.50. Medium: width 5 in., $5.75. Large: width 6 in., $7.00. Each box is a rectangular prism, and the length and height of each box grow with the width.
Question: Which size and how many boxes would you buy? Explain your reasoning.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Find the volume of each box in cubic inches with V = length × width × height, then divide the price by the volume to get a cost per cubic inch of popcorn. The box with the lowest cost per cubic inch is the best value for the money. Then decide how many to buy from how much popcorn your family will actually eat — buying a second cheap-per-inch box is only a good deal if the popcorn gets eaten. A complete answer names the volumes, names the unit costs, and says which one the choice is based on.

reviewCheck.stem: Two storage bins: Bin A is 8 × 6 × 5 inches. Bin B is 9 × 4 × 7 inches. Which holds more and by how much?
reviewCheck.explanation: Bin A: 8 × 6 × 5 = 240 in³. Bin B: 9 × 4 × 7 = 252 in³. Bin B holds 12 in³ more.
choiceFeedback: Calculate both volumes first: Bin A = 8 × 6 × 5 and Bin B = 9 × 4 × 7.
Which bin has the larger volume? Find the difference.
hints: This is a two-part question: which bin holds more AND by how many cubic inches. You need both volumes first.
Find each volume with V = l × w × h, then subtract the smaller total from the larger to get the difference.
Start with Bin A: 8 × 6 = 48, then × 5. Next do Bin B: 9 × 4 = 36, then × 7. Compare the totals.
reviewCheck.stemEs: Dos cajas de almacenamiento: la Caja A mide 8 × 6 × 5 pulgadas. La Caja B mide 9 × 4 × 7 pulgadas. ¿Cuál guarda más y por cuánto?
reviewCheck.explanationEs: Caja A: 8 × 6 × 5 = 240 in³. Caja B: 9 × 4 × 7 = 252 in³. La Caja B guarda 12 in³ más.
hintsEs: Esta pregunta tiene dos partes: cuál caja guarda más Y por cuántas pulgadas cúbicas. Necesitas ambos volúmenes primero.
Halla cada volumen con V = l × a × h y luego resta el total menor del mayor para obtener la diferencia.
Empieza con la Caja A: 8 × 6 = 48 y luego × 5. Después la Caja B: 9 × 4 = 36 y luego × 7. Compara los totales.
